facts.merged_content: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson had annual revenue of 247.88B in 2024.

Adjusted EBITA margin at 14.1 per cent in 2024.
Ericsson's adjusted core earnings were 7.33 billion crowns compared with 3.9 billion crowns reported a year earlier.
Net sales were 61.8 billion Swedish crowns ($5.92 billion) and Ericsson generated SEK 61.8 billion ($5.93 billion) in revenues.

Ericsson's writedown of the value of its cloud-based communications platform unit Vonage was $2.9 billion in 2023.
Cloud Software and Services contributed SEK 15 billion ($1.44 billion) in revenues, down from SEK 15.6 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson had annual revenue of 247.88B SEK. In 2024, Ericsson made a revenue of $23.35 Billion USD, a decrease from $25.01 Billion USD in 2023.
In 2024, Ericsson made a revenue of $23.35 Billion USD, a decrease from $25.01 Billion USD in 2023.
Expected EPS is $0.50 for the fiscal year 2024. P/E multiple is 15.3x for the fiscal year 2024.

Sales increased by 2% year-on-year. Net sales declined by 4%. Sales rose by 54% in North America. Sales declined by 5%. Europe and Latin American markets witnessed a 2% year-over-year decline to SEK 15.2 billion ($1.46 billion).

Sales of SEK 62.635 billion from Cloud Software and Services. The revenue estimate for the Cloud Software and Services segment is SEK 18.04 billion. The estimate for revenues from the Enterprise business is SEK 7.4 billion.

Ericsson's organic revenues down by 10% to SEK263.4bn ($25.2bn) in 2023. Ericsson's EBITA down by 49% to SEK14.9bn ($1.43bn) in 2023. 9,000 roles were cut by Ericsson in 2023, resulting in $623m of restructuring costs.
